title: Why, and What For
label: ch:ur-why-and-what-for
canDo: I can ask why and who, answer why with a cause using کیونکہ or with a purpose using کے لیے, and report what I think with کہ.

payoff.summary: Urdu's k- question family is completed -- کیا, کہاں, کیوں, کون -- and the reader answers کیوں two different ways, with a cause and with a purpose, then reports an opinion over سوچنا from chapter seven.
payoff.note: کیونکہ is built from this chapter's own کیوں and کہ, so the payoff is the chapter taking itself apart.
